CLE won 2 of 4 factors: shooting, getting to the line. Effective FG% 63.1 to 43.5.
Biggest swing: Isaac Okoro makes 23-foot three point jumper (Evan Mobley assists) (Q3 8:17), +5 points of CLE win probability.
